items.title: Last observed playback failure
items.subtitle: The video decoder reported an error. Try an available AVC format at up to 1080p30 SDR in Playback health & rescue.

items.title: Recovery options
items.subtitle: During playback, press R2 and select Playback health & rescue to review lower-quality and compatible AVC alternatives. Alternatives depend on the formats alrea

items.title: Default codec
items.subtitle: Select Auto or another supported codec for future resolves
